name: claude-codex-quota-mac
description: Claude、Codex、Google、Grok 與 Perch 五個 macOS 用量面板。
author: michelle0812

scripts.install:all: npm run install:claude && npm run install:codex && npm run install:google && npm run install:grok && npm run install:perch
scripts.start:claude: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/claude run start
scripts.start:codex: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/codex run start
scripts.start:google: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/google run start
scripts.start:grok: npm run heal-electron && npm --prefix apps/grok run start
scripts.test:all: npm run test:claude && npm run test:codex && npm run test:google && npm run test:grok && npm run test:perch
scripts.build:all: npm run build:claude && npm run build:codex && npm run build:google && npm run build:grok && npm run build:perch
